items.question: What proportional measures determine the cage width and the remaining garland interval in this layout?
premises: The divided area yields a half-part measure.
This half-part is assigned as the cage width.
The remainder is assigned as the interval between garlands.
items.inference: Therefore, the cage width should be one half-part and the remaining space should form the garland interval.
uncertainties: The exact architectural referents of paṃjara and hāra depend on the broader ritual or structural context.
items.plain_english: The cage width should be half a part, and the remainder should be the interval between the garlands.
